Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $0.59 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
Our cloud segment grew 7% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 37 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 37 basis points to 57.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 7% to 19% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
